name: Siljansvik AB (publ)
summary: Siljansvik AB (publ), a Swedish company headquartered in Leksand and founded in 1897, specializes in providing digital communication and energy services throughout Sweden. Its core operations encompass managing an electricity power grid, overseeing a fiber optic network, and engaging in the construction of new residential properties. The entity, which currently operates as Dala Energi AB (publ), is scheduled to officially adopt the name Siljansvik AB (publ) in December 2025.
